guarantees: Explicit current /imagen command and isolated provider tool policy; no vision-to-generation inference, Web/API mode or model fallback added.

Real Create/Upload/Manage use cases exercised together with synthetic authority, SQL, inspector and object-store boundaries: authorized bytes preserve identity/MIME/hash; denied authority stops before PUT.

Uncertain PUT, failed GET, corrupted readback hash, mismatched MIME or permission loss never returns a successful stored image. Unbound output is expired with a cleanup witness when discard is authorized; there is no provider or PUT retry.

Permanent permission loss preserves the original error even when discard is denied; the ready object remains associated with its chat and byte reservation, rather than becoming an unidentified object.

Stage persist rejects expired or revoked attachment read authority before inserting image part or assistant binding; no second adapter execution. This test does not independently prove PostgreSQL rollback.
Cleanup tests cover exact-generation ownership, journal-before-delete, uncertain DELETE/ACK, stale ready-intent refusal and no deletion before the bounded late-PUT window.
Native actual PNG decoder tests reject corrupt/oversized/multiframe/nonimage outputs; closed role/hook/reference, filename/path/NOFOLLOW/link/size and one-image guards remain tested.
No runtime production bug or new permission/cleanup bypass was found in this matrix; production source was not modified.
